tables.title: Batter vs today's starter: pitch-type matchups (all games)
tables.note: Matchup xwOBA = the batter's expected wOBA against each pitch type, weighted by how often today's starter throws it ('coverage' = share of the mix with enough sample). Edge = matchup xwOBA minus the batter's overall xwOBA: +.025 or more is a good matchup for hits / bases / H+R+RBI props; −.025 or worse leans unders. Percentiles: 100 = best.
